title: the Weeping Wood Rising Anew
author: Xanthe Eriksen
blurb: Dominic Winterbourne, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
